messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy: embed-service v2.4.1 -> prod (canary 10%)
deploy-bot: Canary instances: 5 -> target 5
Alex Chen: rolling now, should be quick. keeping an eye on p95 and 5xx.
Maria Gomez: copying dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ABCD/embed-service?orgId=1
alerts-bot: SLO ALERT: service=embed-service endpoint=/generate metric=p95 latency threshold=1.0s window=5m current=1.45s :warning:
Samir Patel: saw that, looking at traces. traces: https://jaeger/redwood/traces?service=embed-service
Jen O'Neil: can we get logs for the canary pods? `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/embed-service -l canary=true --tail=200`
Samir Patel: grabbing logs, past 3 minutes lots of `KV cache miss` and `OOM` on model-worker-2
Alex Chen: OOM on canary? that's worrying. Could be quantized kernel mismatch.
Maria Gomez: p50 is fine, p95 spike. so maybe a tail-case memory pressure under longer context. Any config diff between v2.4.1 and v2.4.0?
Alex Chen: v2.4.1 enabled streaming-prefetch and uses a different attention kernel. config diff: `attention_kernel=optimized_v2`
Jen O'Neil: recommend pausing traffic to canary and rolling back to 2.4.0 until we debug. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: +1. We can also throttle request routing: `redwood route set embed-service --canary-weight 0`
deploy-bot: Canary update: embed-service canary weight set to 0% by @Jen O'Neil
alerts-bot: INFO: canary weight change detected by routing controller
Alex Chen: initiating rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embed-service --to-revision=123` (targeting v2.4.0)
deploy-bot: Rollback started: embed-service -> v2.4.0 (requested by Alex Chen)
Maria Gomez: watching dashboards. p95 trending back down to 0.9s :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: logs show OOMs stop after canary removed. collecting core dumps for root cause.
Jen O'Neil: will open a post-deploy ticket with stack traces and config diffs. tagging infra and runtime teams.
Alex Chen: thanks — we'll hold this release until runtime team signs off. Marking this change as blocked in release notes.
deploy-bot: Release note update: embed-service v2.4.1 paused — rollback performed. (automated)
Maria Gomez: file: https://tickets.redwood/internal/INC-9876
Samir Patel: will queue a smaller canary with kernel fallback to see if it's deterministic.
Jen O'Neil: nice work everyone. If alerts re-fire, we'll escalate oncall.
alerts-bot: SLO STATUS: embed-service p95=0.88s 5xx_rate=0.3% (back within SLO)
Alex Chen: closing thread for now. Followups on INC-9876.
